name: v0.1.2
body:
This is a security release updating Go toolchain to address recent vulnerability findings.

## Changelog
* 79b189b4695ab2f404a8a7ac3f9e1f0ea67dcf71: Fix zizmor action pin comments (@kpumuk)
* ad7062d3b010a4fdc282ea39f9dcff1b937284ad: Align scorecards SARIF upload pin (@kpumuk)
* c11f10317494a91ada9e6d6a01f5560b9d274fb7: Fix checkout pin version comments (@kpumuk)
* 9a9e08a47fdb9a35035d2d14777bb331610c217e: Update Go toolchain to 1.26.4 (@kpumuk)
* 860669388bf003cc7e5eef440f7b5b357ad738f6: Fix workflow action pin comments (@kpumuk)
* 963fbef91ca8a734056996e10a4b0c4d9c5c0ec6: Update release attestation action and group CodeQL updates (@kpumuk)
* 3aeec112731f88dd46089c04e431e1805a56ebe2: Bump Go to 1.26.5 (@kpumuk)
* f0a468f9cbf76060f995f4759fe67c9398439311: Upgrade Go toolchain to 1.27 (@kpumuk)
